in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is unhappy or unsteady.

in_marathi.name: Danishtha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Danishtha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Danishtha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Danishtha’ meaning ‘truth’. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Satya, who is the embodiment of truth. The name Danishtha is believed to bring clarity and honesty in one’s thoughts and actions.
